newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold prices dip slightly, demand steady.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold prices dip slightly, demand steady.

text.p: The Istanbul gold market sustained lively trade on Wednesday with volume at 1,875 kilos compared to Tuesday's 1,893 kilos as prices moved slightly lower.
Gold closed a touch easier at $325.20 an ounce and 1,648,000 lira per gram, compared to $325.75 and 1,649,000 lira on Tuesday.
"There is a steady amount of physical demand coming from the market now as the season for marriages and celebrations gets into full swing - this is supporting trade at the moment," one dealer said.
The Turkish currency fell to 157,300 to the dollar versus Tuesday's 156,310 lira.
Most of the day's trade -- 1,230 kilos -- took place in the afternoon session, with 57.1 percent conducted in lira terms.
